notes: Tuition: the pages give no fee amount for this programme, only "fee-paying applicants" with no figure, so no tuition fact is stated. The Studyfinder page gives two contradictory duration strings: a header field "Duration of the course / programme: 1 semster" (likely an error) and "COURSE STRUCTURE: Semesters: 7 ... Credits altogether: 210" on the programme's own page; 3.5 years is based on 7 semesters. The "Duration" header field also lists the location as Baja, while the programme page says Baja. Stipendium Hungaricum is marked "Not available" for this programme on Studyfinder, hence the direct-application channel. The English-language requirement is quoted from the Studyfinder page; the admission page also mentions an "English language certificate" as a required document.
